_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Misadventure on the Sea#000.src: Sitting on this stool will start Misadventure on the Sea.
Misadventure on the Sea#000.dst: Si te sientas en este taburete, empezará Desventura en el mar.

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: I'll take two {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#001.dst: Ponme dos whiskys de {p}. Uno para mí y otro para este amigo.

Misadventure on the Sea#003.src: I'll wait for ya at the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#003.dst: Te espero en el muelle. ¡Tranquilo, no tiene pérdida!

Misadventure on the Sea#005.src: They're a bit too head on, don't you think?

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: I'm tryin' to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#006.dst: Intento virar el barco pero no se mueve...

Misadventure on the Sea#007.src: Sounds like you're being dragged around...
Misadventure on the Sea#007.dst: Parece que te están arrastrando de un lado a otro...

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: You pick up a small sign...

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: So, there's quite a few bodies in there, and we never bothered throwin' em out!
Misadventure on the Sea#010.dst: Ahí dentro hay unos cuantos cuerpos, ¡y nunca nos molestamos en sacarlos!

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the bodies with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#011.dst: Adelante, toma también una esponja para la sangre seca. ¡A los cuerpos, dales con ella!

Misadventure on the Sea#013.src: You take a look inside the furnaces...
Misadventure on the Sea#013.dst: Echas un vistazo dentro de los hornos...

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.
Misadventure on the Sea#015.dst: Una cantidad absurda de virutas de madera, por algún motivo.

Misadventure on the Sea#016.src: Looks like the door that leads to the hold...
Misadventure on the Sea#016.dst: Parece la puerta que lleva a la bodega...

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: It's locked. Probably because of the rat issue. Honip must have the key.
Misadventure on the Sea#017.dst: Está cerrada. Seguramente por lo de las ratas. Honip debe de tener la llave.

Misadventure on the Sea#018.src: You find some notes on the table.
Misadventure on the Sea#018.dst: Encuentras unas notas en la mesa.

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?
Misadventure on the Sea#019.dst: Mencionan... ¿Un cañón humano? ¿Qué sentido tiene eso?

Misadventure on the Sea#020.src: Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.
Misadventure on the Sea#020.dst: Al parecer, solo hace falta pólvora y una mecha.

Misadventure on the Sea#021.src: This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.
Misadventure on the Sea#021.dst: Este cañón apunta un poco hacia arriba y parece menos potente que los demás.

Misadventure on the Sea#022.src: According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
Misadventure on the Sea#022.dst: Según las notas que viste, seguramente es el cañón "humano". ¡Esta debe de ser tu vía de escape!

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...
Misadventure on the Sea#024.dst: Mencionan una llave escondida en la bodega...

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: You should probably search the hold later, when possible.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.dst: Deberías registrar la bodega más tarde, cuando puedas.

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#026.dst: ¡Has limpiado los cuerpos! Deberías hablar con Honip en cubierta.

Misadventure on the Sea#027.src: 'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!
Misadventure on the Sea#027.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Qué tal la limpieza? No olvides mirar por todas partes, ¡nunca se sabe lo que puedes encontrar!

Misadventure on the Sea#028.src: You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.
Misadventure on the Sea#028.dst: ¿Ya has terminado? ¡Buen trabajo! Honip está junto al timón, si lo buscas.

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: You've been running around the boat for a while now!
Misadventure on the Sea#029.dst: ¡Llevas un buen rato correteando por el barco!

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.
Misadventure on the Sea#031.dst: ¡Honip ya estará esperándote! Sube por estas escaleras de mi lado, está ahí arriba.

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#032.dst: Si pierdes la esponja, Honip puede darte otra en cubierta.

Misadventure on the Sea#033.src: The only boat that will take ye directly to {p}.
Misadventure on the Sea#033.dst: El único barco que te lleva directo a {p}.

Misadventure on the Sea#034.src: Hey! You aren't allowed on my ship!

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: This hologram will teleport you back on the island to continue the quest or Reset your quest.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: Este holograma te teletransportará de vuelta a la isla para continuar la misión, o reiniciará tu misión.

Misadventure on the Sea#036.src: Are you sure you wish to Reset your quest?

Misadventure on the Sea#037.src: Misadventure On The Sea has been reset!
Misadventure on the Sea#037.dst: ¡Desventura en el mar se ha reiniciado!

Misadventure on the Sea#038.src: Maybe you could somehow use it..? There's no way to tell how dangerous it is. Probably very.
Misadventure on the Sea#038.dst: ¿Quizá podrías usarlo de algún modo..? No hay forma de saber lo peligroso que es. Mucho, seguramente.

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: It must be the one up you saw up there! That's got to be the way to escape!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: ¡Debe de ser el que viste ahí arriba! ¡Esa tiene que ser la salida!

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: Who knows, maybe there's gunpowder in there?
Misadventure on the Sea#040.dst: Quién sabe, ¿igual hay pólvora ahí dentro?

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: Seems like it likes you now!

Misadventure on the Sea#042.src: Not done yet? Well, take your time!

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: We sometimes hear unusually loud footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#043.dst: A veces oímos pasos de lo más sonoros, y unos chillidos muy siniestros...

Misadventure on the Sea#044.src: Looks like this crate is filled with rat hair, with some eaten carrots.
Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: Parece que esta caja está llena de pelo de rata y zanahorias mordisqueadas.

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: You defeated the rats! You should grab the gunpowder and the fuse before leaving.
Misadventure on the Sea#045.dst: ¡Has derrotado a las ratas! Deberías coger la pólvora y la mecha antes de irte.

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: Looks like this crate is filled with even more rat hair!
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: ¡Parece que esta caja está llena de aún más pelo de rata!

Misadventure on the Sea#050.src: You picked up a dusty key!

Misadventure on the Sea#053.src: You got the fuse as well as the gunpowder. Looks like you can use that cannon now!
Misadventure on the Sea#053.dst: Tienes la mecha y también la pólvora. ¡Parece que ya puedes usar ese cañón!

Misadventure on the Sea#054.src: You put the gunpowder in the cannon and attach the fuse...
Misadventure on the Sea#054.dst: Metes la pólvora en el cañón y colocas la mecha...

Misadventure on the Sea#055.src: Looks like it's fully functional. Make sure the pirates don't see you! Once you leave, you won't be able to come back.
Misadventure on the Sea#055.dst: Parece que funciona perfectamente. ¡Que no te vean los piratas! Una vez te vayas, no podrás volver.

Misadventure on the Sea#056.dst: Te metes a gatas en el cañón...

Misadventure on the Sea#061.src: Huh? Something's approaching off in the distance...
Misadventure on the Sea#061.dst: ¿Eh? Algo se acerca a lo lejos...

Misadventure on the Sea#062.src: Looks like they're headed toward the island! Is that..?
Misadventure on the Sea#062.dst: ¡Parece que vienen hacia la isla! ¿Eso es..?

Misadventure on the Sea#063.src: Ah... Trust. Say, why don't I make it so you can travel to {p} for free? That way, if ya ever think o' doin' somethin' foolish like that again, ya can jus' take a trip on my ol' ship!
Misadventure on the Sea#063.dst: Ah... Confianza. Oye, ¿y si hago que puedas viajar a {p} gratis? Así, si alguna vez piensas en hacer otra tontería así, ¡te das un paseo en mi viejo barco!

Misadventure on the Sea#065.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#065.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#066.src: I'll take {~} {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.dst: Ponme {~} whiskys de {p}. Uno para mí y otro para este amigo.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#068.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#068.dst: Oye... te he visto por el pueblo. Vi lo contento que se puso aquel tipo cuando le llevaste un diario.
Misadventure on the Sea#068.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#070.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#070.dst: Bueno... soldado. ¿Te animas a surcar el mar conmigo? ¡Tengo un barco mucho más fino que ese Seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#070.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#071.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#071.dst: ¡Me imaginé que te interesaría explorar las aguas!
Misadventure on the Sea#071.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: Te espero en el muelle. ¡Tranquilo, no tiene pérdida!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#074.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#074.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: Mira esto... ¡Magnífico! ¡Mucho mejor que lo que usa el Seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#077.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#079.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#079.dst: Oye... debo avisarte, esta es mi primera vez al timón...
Misadventure on the Sea#079.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: Aunque no parece muy difícil, un poco a la izquierda...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#081.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#081.dst: Mmm, parece que hoy no somos los únicos en el agua.
Misadventure on the Sea#081.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#083.src: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#083.dst: Intento virar el barco pero no se mueve...
Misadventure on the Sea#083.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#087.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#087.dst: De verdad que no me creo que picaras. Te lo resumo...
Misadventure on the Sea#087.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#088.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.dst: Se te acerca un pirata sospechosísimo, te invita a una copa y te lleva a su barco sospechoso.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: Cualquier persona normal se habría dado la vuelta. ¿Y tú? ¡Tú subes! Pues nada, ahora te quedas con nosotros.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#090.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.dst: Voy al grano: este barco necesita arreglos, y los harás tú.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#091.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#091.dst: ¿Por qué? ¡Eres soldado! ¡Si solo sabes obedecer órdenes! En fin, nos limpiarás las cosas. Venga, fuera.
Misadventure on the Sea#091.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#093.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#093.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#095.src: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
Misadventure on the Sea#095.dst: Ahí dentro hay unos cuantos esqueletos, ¡y nunca nos molestamos en sacarlos!
Misadventure on the Sea#095.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: Adelante, toma también una esponja para la sangre seca. ¡A los esqueletos, dales con ella!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: Si me necesitas, estaré en cubierta. Y, eh, no entres en la bodega. Tenemos un GRAN problema de ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#098.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#098.dst: Ah, y por el bien de mi tripulación, ¿podrías colaborar más? No tengo pociones de estas para siempre.
Misadventure on the Sea#098.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#099.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#099.dst: Limpia los cuerpos del barco. Busca al mismo tiempo pistas para escapar. -Cuerpos limpiados: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#100.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#100.dst: Eh, ¿o sea que eres nuestro guardia?
Misadventure on the Sea#100.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#102.dst: Esa escalera baja a la bodega, pero ahora está cerrada... Tenemos un caso grave de ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#102.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: Pep es un tesoro, ¿a que sí? ¡Me alegra que tú también lo cuides!
Misadventure on the Sea#103.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.dst: Honip tiene un pollo por mascota, ¿no?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#105.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#105.dst: Seguro que se inspiró en aquel tipo raro de su isla...
Misadventure on the Sea#105.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: ¿Qué? ¿Mataste el pollo más preciado de aquel tipo? Qué raro eres, soldado.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#107.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#107.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#109.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#109.dst: ¡Ah, ese es mi cañón! Mola, ¿eh? Lo hice con un montón de braz- Nada, olvídalo...
Misadventure on the Sea#109.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: Es un pollo fuerte, eso te lo aseguro.
Misadventure on the Sea#111.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#113.dst: Yo me voy a... quedar aquí... con mis cañones...
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#114.dst: Habla con Honip en cubierta para recibir tu próxima tarea

Misadventure on the Sea#115.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#115.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#116.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.dst: Igual te dejo descansar as- espera.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.dst: ¡Ho-Honip! ¡Uno de los chicos dice que ha visto algo rarísimo viniendo hacia nosotros!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#120.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.dst: ¡N-no lo sabemos! No se ve bien, ¡pero parece enorme!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#122.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.dst: Eh... ¿Y dónde se supone que tengo que mirar?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#123.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#123.dst: ¡Te lo juro, hace nada parecía que el mar entero enloquecía!
Misadventure on the Sea#123.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#124.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#124.dst: Como sea otra de vuestras bromas...
Misadventure on the Sea#124.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#127.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#127.dst: ¡No lo sé, esto no estaba planeado!
Misadventure on the Sea#127.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#128.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#128.dst: ¡Soldado, ha llegado tu momento! ¡Espántalo con uno de tus hechizos o algo!
Misadventure on the Sea#128.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#133.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#133.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#134.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#134.dst: ¡Menudo espectáculo! Ven, tengo cosas que contarte.
Misadventure on the Sea#134.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#135.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.dst: No sé de dónde salió esa criatura, pero gracias a ti se ha ido.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#136.src: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.dst: Tengo otro asunto para ti. Es sobre... las ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#137.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#137.dst: Ven a la bodega, te explico por el camino.
Misadventure on the Sea#137.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#138.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#138.dst: Creo que tenemos entre manos un problema infernal.
Misadventure on the Sea#138.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#139.src: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#139.dst: No sé qué te encontrarás ahí, pero esas NO son ratas normales.
Misadventure on the Sea#139.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#140.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#140.dst: Así que entra, por favor... y mátalo todo, ¿vale?
Misadventure on the Sea#140.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#141.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#141.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#142.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#142.dst: ¡Soldado, ha llegado tu momento! ¡Espántalo con uno de tus hechizos o algo!
Misadventure on the Sea#142.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#143.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#143.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#144.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#144.dst: Eso ha sido... Uf... Menudo asunto.
Misadventure on the Sea#144.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#145.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#145.dst: Y ahora, una sorpresa aún mayor...
Misadventure on the Sea#145.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#146.src: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#146.dst: ¿¡Qué demonios, soldado!? ¿Qué parte de "soldado" no entiendes?
Misadventure on the Sea#146.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#147.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#147.dst: Ven, vamos a aclarar unas cosas.
Misadventure on the Sea#147.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#148.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#148.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#149.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#149.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#150.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.dst: Sígueme, te explico por el camino.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#151.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#151.dst: Antes mencioné un problema de ratas... No es, eh, pequeño.
Misadventure on the Sea#151.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#152.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.dst: Hay que recuperar pólvora, así que tú vas a limpiar la bodega.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#153.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#153.dst: Así que entra... e intenta matarlo todo, ¿vale?
Misadventure on the Sea#153.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#154.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#154.dst: No lo hagas tan mal como antes. Eres soldado.
Misadventure on the Sea#154.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#157.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#157.dst: ¡Esperaba que hicieras algo TÚ, soldado, no él!
Misadventure on the Sea#157.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#158.dst: En fin, ven a hablar conmigo.
Misadventure on the Sea#158.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#159.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.dst: Tengo otra tarea para ti. Es sobre... las ratas.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#160.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#160.dst: Verás, no creo que sea un problema de los normales.
Misadventure on the Sea#160.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#161.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#161.dst: Ven a la bodega, te explico por el camino.
Misadventure on the Sea#161.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#162.src: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#162.dst: A veces oímos pasos de lo más sonoros, y unos chillidos muy siniestros...
Misadventure on the Sea#162.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#163.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#163.dst: Por eso no nos hace gracia entrar... ¡Pero la pólvora está ahí! ¡La necesitamos, somos piratas!
Misadventure on the Sea#163.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#164.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#164.dst: Así que entra... y mátalo todo, ¿vale?
Misadventure on the Sea#164.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#165.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#165.dst: A por todas. ¡Snoo, tú te quedas!
Misadventure on the Sea#165.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#166.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats
Misadventure on the Sea#166.dst: Explora la bodega y mata a las ratas

Misadventure on the Sea#167.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
Misadventure on the Sea#167.dst: Derrota al Colossal Rat en la bodega

Misadventure on the Sea#168.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Misadventure on the Sea#168.dst: Usa la pólvora y la mecha para activar el cañón y escapar

Misadventure on the Sea#169.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#169.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#170.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#170.dst: ¿Te cargaste a esos malditos roedores? ¿Una... Colossal Rat, dices?
Misadventure on the Sea#170.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#171.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#171.dst: ¡Bien hecho, sabía que podía contar contigo! ¡Ven, toma esto!
Misadventure on the Sea#171.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#172.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#172.dst: En fin, por ahora puedes descansar y hacer lo que quieras.
Misadventure on the Sea#172.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#173.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#173.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#174.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#174.dst: ¿Te cargaste a esos malditos roedores? ¿Una... Colossal Rat, dices?
Misadventure on the Sea#174.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#175.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#175.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#176.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#176.dst: En fin, por ahora puedes descansar y hacer lo que quieras.
Misadventure on the Sea#176.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#177.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#177.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#178.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#178.dst: ¿Te cargaste a esos malditos roedores? ¿Una... Colossal Rat, dices?
Misadventure on the Sea#178.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#179.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#179.dst: ¡Eso suena aterrador! ¡Y lo hiciste tú solo! ¿Sabes qué? Toma, quédate esto.
Misadventure on the Sea#179.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#180.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#180.dst: En fin, por ahora puedes descansar y hacer lo que quieras.
Misadventure on the Sea#180.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#181.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#181.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#183.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#183.dst: No, ¡pero hizo un gran trabajo en la bodega! Aunque falta algo de pólvora.
Misadventure on the Sea#183.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#187.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#187.dst: Averigua dónde estás y cómo huir de la isla

Misadventure on the Sea#188.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#188.dst: ¡Eh, soldado! ¡Parece que estás en un apuro! ¿Qué tal si subes?
Misadventure on the Sea#188.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#189.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#189.dst: Bueno... ¡Vamos a {p}, el corazón del océano! Más seguro que donde estabas, ¡je!
Misadventure on the Sea#189.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#190.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#190.dst: Iba dando un rodeo turístico cuando te vi a ti y a tu equipo reluciente en esa isla.
Misadventure on the Sea#190.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#191.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#191.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#192.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#192.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#193.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.dst: ¡Eso te pasa por evitar al viejo Seaskipper! Soy el único de fiar por aquí.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#194.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#194.dst: ¡Espero que no te trataran muy mal! Mira, te llevo a {p} gratis como compensación.
Misadventure on the Sea#194.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#195.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#195.dst: ¡Ya veo la costa a lo lejos! ¡Agárrate, casi hemos llegado!
Misadventure on the Sea#195.speaker: Seaskipper Captain
